text:
alex: heads up — hitting 401 when streaming with the new JS SDK inside a Docker image. Works on my laptop. PR #987. anyone seen this?

sam: quick check — are you passing the API key via env or a mounted secret file? docker-compose sometimes preserves quotes if the secret was authored with them.

alex: using env: `- API_KEY=${API_KEY}` in compose. locally `echo $API_KEY` looks normal, but inside node `console.log(process.env.API_KEY)` prints a value with surrounding double quotes.

jun: interesting. can you paste the outgoing header from a failed request (curl or server-side logs)?

alex: here's the debug header from our proxy logs:
```
Authorization: Basic "YWJjOmRlZg=="
```

maria: yup — that explains the 401. the base64 token has quotes included, so server sees `"YWJjOmRlZg=="` instead of `YWJjOmRlZg==`. basic auth must not have quotes.

sam: two ways to fix: ensure the secret provider writes raw string (use `jq -r` when templating) OR strip quotes in the app as a defensive measure.

alex: i'll ship a tiny patch to strip surrounding quotes in SDK client creation as a short-term fix, then we can improve secret templates. pinging @maria to review PR #987.

maria: SG. recommended normalization: `const norm = (s) => (s || '').trim().replace(/^\"|\"$/g, '')` and add a unit test for env variants (with and without quotes / with whitespace).

jun: also add a short docs blurb: "loading keys from envs and docker secrets — avoid including literal quotes" with an example `docker secret` usage (`echo -n` vs `echo`).

ci-bot: CI: build failed on the branch — lint error in auth_helper.js line 12 (trailing semicolon).

sam: i'll tidy lint in the branch and add the normalize helper to the SDK wrapper to reduce user footguns.

alex: thanks all — i'll push the fix, add the test + docs note, and re-run CI. resolving this thread offline. :thumbsup:
